fields.statement: At 196c50e2 ran go test -trimpath ./internal/tui/runsapp/... ./internal/tui/daemonapp/... ./internal/tui/autonomyapp/... (ok) and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestTUI (TestTUIAppHeaders, TestTUISettingsScopes PASS); gofmt and go vet clean. TestMergedTagsRunsByProject runs the Runs app over projects alpha and beta and sees rows tagged 'alpha · Alpha work' and 'beta · Beta work', newest first, finished run dropped. TestTUISettingsScopes registers alpha and beta under a root, opens the Autonomy app in beta and toggles ship to owner: beta's git config gets rhiza.autonomy.ship=owner and alpha's stays unset; the Daemon app's run limit 7 lands in the root's rhiza.toml and not in git config. Read the diff: tui.go wires the merged runs model when projects are registered and daemonapp.NewIn with the current project; daemonapp adds project pause and run-cap fields writing rhiza.project.* keys. Checked by hand with a scratch build in a scratch root (two projects, RHIZA_* unset): daemon set of rhiza.daemon.maxRuns 7 wrote [daemon] in rhiza.toml, rhiza.project.maxRuns and rhiza.autonomy.ship wrote only beta's git config, and daemon settings lists each key once with its scope.
